class Point {

  final int _x;
  final int _y;
  final String label;
  int _scale;

  Point({required this._x, required this._y, this.label = 'p', this._scale = 1});

  int get x {
    return this._x;
  }

  int get area {
    return (this._x * this._y) * this._scale;
  }
